projects.name: Point (August 2025 – Present)
details: • Develop and enhance ServiceNow Service Catalog capabilities including Catalog Items, Record
Producers, and Order Guides to support enterprise service-request processes.
• Customize Service Portal pages and widgets and enhance user-facing experiences using HTML, CSS, and
AngularJS.
• Develop and configure REST API integrations and leverage IntegrationHub capabilities for system
integration and data exchange.
• Build Flow Designer automations and Decision Table logic to streamline business processes and reduce
manual activities.
• Configure Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Catalog Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions,
ACLs, and Server-Side Scripts based on business requirements.
• Configure Import Sets, Transform Maps, Scheduled Jobs, Email Notifications, and Email Scripts for data
processing and platform automation.
• Develop and maintain Reports, Dashboards, and Performance Analytics to support operational visibility.
• Participate in requirement gathering, Agile ceremonies, development, testing, UAT, deployment, and
production support activities.
• Troubleshoot application and platform issues and support post-deployment stabilization and defect
resolution.
